physics: paused; no fluid, thermal, optical, crystallization, electrical, chemistry or material simulation is claimed
observations: Explicitly synthetic service displays and records become visible only after corresponding acquisition/completion events. They must carry mock=true and provenance.
hidden_state: Evaluator may privately seed missing labels, stock shortages, mask errors, calibration failures, dropout, drift, damaged proxies or mismatched report IDs. Actor receives only physically/publicly observable evidence.
non_scientific_success: Target is not forced to outperform control; no mock value is evidence for the paper's scientific claims.
time_policy: Service clock can be compressed for 24 h, ten days, 600 h and 1000 h routes. Record real elapsed versus simulated episode time separately. A skipped interval is not a measured interval.
service_boundary: Robot manipulates inert exterior objects, masks, carriers, fixtures and reversible connectors. Hazardous operations occur only as named nonphysical closed-service transitions.
manual_dexterity_boundary: Crystal picking, chemical portions, sealed solution transfers, sectioning, deposition, gas/pressure services and microscopic beam alignment use explicitly authored service affordances; no real-hardware skill claim.

scenario_cases.outcome: All public readiness gates and acquisitions valid; finish with closed manifest.
Accept labelled mock-only unresolved card or report explicit blocker; never invent a recipe.
Recover before irreversible mixing or quarantine and remake afterward.
Preserve invalid points and state-dependent reacquisition policy.
Use distinct sufficient-stock sibling or end with shortage blocker.
Save raw data and unknown derived results.
